convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh library (LongShortExpertModified.mqh) which implements custom position gating logic (long/short/both) not present in standard CExpert. Signal/trailing/money modules are from standard library but the core expert class is custom.

other_exits: Opposite MACD signal closes existing position via CExpert default reversal logic

custom_logic_notes: CLongShortExpertModified extends CExpert with SetAvailablePositions() method that gates position entry based on ENUM_AVAILABLE_POSITIONS (BOTH_POSITION, LONG_ONLY, SHORT_ONLY). This allows restricting the EA to only long, only short, or both directions - a feature not in standard CExpert. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated only on new bar completion, not every tick.
python_conversion_notes: The core custom class CLongShortExpertModified must be reverse-engineered from the .mqh file. Its SetAvailablePositions() method is the key addition over standard CExpert - it filters trade direction before order placement. The MACD signal logic is standard (SignalMACD.mqh) and can be replicated with ta-lib or pandas-ta MACD. SL/TP are fixed pip values (20/50) - ensure pip-to-price conversion accounts for 5-digit brokers by checking _Digits/_Point. No trailing stop logic (TrailingNone). No money management (MoneyNone) - default lot sizing used. The bar-open-only execution (Expert_EveryTick=false) means Python should evaluate signals at bar close, not on every tick.
